== Title ==
<span lang="ja">インペリアル・ガンナー（砲手）</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">宇宙船に乗客として搭乗しているなら宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に１を加える。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ウォーカーは2人組で操作する。1名はAT-ATを操縦する訓練を受けており、もう1名は砲手として働く。インペリアル・ガンナーは自分たちを帝国最高の砲手と自称している。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Imperial Gunner.

'''Lore''' — Walker operators work in pairs. One is trained to pilot the AT-AT, and the other works as a gunner. Imperial gunners call themselves the Empire’s finest gunners.

'''Game text''' — If aboard a starship as a passenger, add 1 to that starship’s weapon destiny.

Both faces add 1 to starship weapon destiny while the gunner is aboard as a passenger. The Japanese lore says they call themselves the Empire’s finest gunners.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-imperialgunner-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Gunner]].</ref>
